result.rationale: In GoogleCalendarService, the diff changes `const key = googleCredentialSchema.parse(googleCredentials);` to `const key = parseRefreshTokenResponse(googleCredentials, googleCredentialSchema);` and then does `prisma.credential.update({ data: { key } })`. parseRefreshTokenResponse returns `refreshTokenResponse` which is the result of `schema.safeParse(response)` — i.e. a ZodSafeParseResult wrapper `{success, data}` — not the parsed flat credential object. Previously credential.key was the flat parsed object; now it stores the wrapper, so consumers reading key.access_token/refresh_token get undef

judged_text: parseRefreshTokenResponse returns the safeParse result object ({success, data}), and GoogleCalendarService stores that wrapper directly as credential.key, replacing the previously stored flat parsed credential object. After any token refresh, credential.key becomes {success: true, data: {...}} instead of the flat googleCredentials shape, so every subsequent consumer reading credential.key.access_token / refresh_token gets undefined and Google Calendar integration breaks after the first refresh.
